name: stats-section-v4
title: Stats Section v4
description: A two-tone heading (title plus muted description) pinned to the top and a 2×2 grid of large stats resting just above the flat end of the curve, over an edge-to-edge growth chart that fills the section: a gray line curving up from the bottom-left above a field of fading hairline bars. Static data, no API.
